A can do 33 ⅓% of a work in 10 days and B can do 20% of the same work in 9 days. They work together in 8 days. C alone completes 30% of the remaining work in 10 days. In how many days will A and C together complete the same work?
A, किसी कार्य के 33 ⅓% भाग को 10 दिन में कर सकता है और B उसी कार्य के 20% भाग को 9 दिन में कर सकता है। वे एक साथ 8 दिन में कार्य करते हैं। अकेले C, शेष कार्य के 30% भाग को 10 दिन में पूरा करता है। एक साथ A और C उसी कार्य को कितने दिन में पूरा करेंगे?
options:
18 days
18 दिन

12 days
12 दिन

15 days
15 दिन

20 days
20 दिन
solution: Assume total work = 100 units.A’s 1-day work = 10/3 and B’s 1-day work = 20/9.(A + B) in 8 days = (10/3 + 20/9) × 8 = 400/9.Remaining work = 100 − 400/9 = 500/9; 30% of it = 50/3.C’s 1-day work = 5/3.Time taken by (A + C) = 100 ÷ (10/3 + 5/3) = 20 days.

question: Direction: Change the following sentence given below in the appropriate narration form. “What a wonderful time we had there” she exclaimed.
options: She exclaimed that she has quite a wonderful time there.

She exclaimed that they had quite a wonderful time there.

solution: The given sentence is,“What a wonderful time we had there” she exclaimed.We change such sentences in indirect narration using the following rules:Said is changed to exclaimedInverted commas (" ") are removed and that is used instead.The verb and tense of the reported speech change accordingly.If the reported verb has words like “what a” or “how”, then we use the word “very” in place of them in the indirect speech.No changes are made to past perfect and past perfect continuous tense.First-person pronoun changes according to the subject of reporting speech.Thus the appropriate narration form is,She exclaimed that they had quite a wonderful time there.

question: Direction: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.Anju said to Vijaya, "You can stay with us whenever you are in Delhi."
options: Anju told Vijaya that she could stay with them whenever she was in Delhi
Anju told Vijaya that you can stay with us whenever you are in Delhi

solution: The correct indirect form of the given sentence is 'Anju told Vijaya that she could stay with them whenever she was in Delhi'.The given sentence is a direct speech. The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added, also, ''said to'' becomes 'told'.The second-person pronoun 'You' becomes the third-person pronoun 'she' and the first-person pronoun 'us' becomes the third-person pronoun 'them'.The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (can) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (could) + Object'.The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (are) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.

options:
Kalibangan
कालीबंगा

Dholavira
धौलावीरा

Kotdiji
कोटदीजी

Aamri
आम्री
solution:
Explanation: In the context of Harappan culture, evidence of rock-cut architecture has been found from Dholavira. Dholavira is a small village situated on the north-western corner of an island named Khadir, called 'Baith' in the local language, in Bhachau taluka of Kutch district of Gujarat. The desert of Kutch is spread around it. Mansar and Manhar are rainy rivers here. Remains of the Indus Valley civilization have been found in the excavation of a mound called Kotada in Dholavira. Dhaula means white and Bira means well. The credit for discovering the mounds of Dholavira in 1967-68 AD goes to J. of the Archaeological Survey of India. To P. Joshi. Excavations here have revealed evidence of a rectangular city layout plan. The city inside the fort is divided into three parts - (1) Fort, 2. Middle city, (3) Lower city. Amino acid derived only

All of the above

solution:

question:

options:
Both A and R are individually true and R is the correct explanation of A
A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है

Both A and R are individually true but R is not a correct explanation of A

A is false but R is true

Explanation: Copper is a better conductor of electricity than iron and does not get easily oxidized in atmospheric conditions, hence copper rods are preferred over iron in making lightning conductors.

options:
Same atomic mass but different atomic number
परमाणु भार समान, परन्तु परमाणु क्रमांक भिन्न होता है

Different atomic mass but same atomic number
परमाणु भार भिन्न, परमाणु क्रमांक समान होता है

Both atomic mass and atomic number are same
परमाणु क्रमांक तथा परमाणु भार समान होते हैं

None of the above
उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
solution:

question:
In which year did Kaithal become a district of Haryana?
कैथल किस वर्ष में हरियाणा का एक जिला बना था?
options: 1985
1986
1987
1989
solution:
Kaithal, which became a district of Haryana in 1989, is located in the north-western part of the state. It shares borders with Punjab, Kurukshetra, Jind, and Karnal. Kaithal holds historical significance, featuring 'Anjani ka Tila' and characterized by seven ponds and eight gates. According to the 2011 census, the district's population is 1,083,211, with 80.61% rural and 19.39% urban residents. The district comprises three sub-divisions, four tehsils, and three sub-tehsils. 89.37% of the people speak Hindi and 10.34% speak Punjabi. The district has four assembly constituencies: Guhla, Kalayat, Kaithal, and Pundri.
कैथल, जो 1989 में हरियाणा का जिला बना, राज्य के उत्तर-पश्चिम में स्थित है। इसकी सीमाएं पंजाब, कुरुक्षेत्र, जींद और करनाल से जुड़ी हुई हैं। कैथल का ऐतिहासिक महत्व है, यहां 'अंजनी का टीला' और सात तालाबों, आठ द्वारों की विशेषता है। 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार, जिले की जनसंख्या 10,83,211 है, जिसमें 80.61% ग्रामीण और 19.39% शहरी लोग हैं। जिले में तीन उपमंडल, चार तहसील और तीन उप-तहसीलें हैं। 89.37% लोग हिंदी और 10.34% पंजाबी बोलते हैं। जिले में चार विधानसभा क्षेत्र - गुहला, कलायत, कैथल और पुंडरी हैं।

question:
Where was the first World Audiovisual and Entertainment Summit (WAVES) 2025 held?
पहला विश्व दृश्य-श्रव्य और मनोरंजन शिखर सम्मेलन (वेव्स) 2025 का आयोजन कहाँ किया गया?

Nagpur
नागपुर

Jaipur
जयपुर

Bhopal
भोपाल

Mumbai
मुंबई
solution:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the first World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit (WAVES) 2025 at Jio World Centre in Mumbai on 1 May 2025. The conference was organised with the aim of bringing the Indian media and entertainment industry to the global platform. WAVES 2025 focused on sectors such as film broadcasting, digital media, animation, radio, VFX, gaming, music, advertising and other related technologies. During the conference, the government also organised a global media dialogue aimed at promoting open and fair trade practices. Organised by the Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, the event ran from 1-4 May 2025. The main objective of WAVES 2025 is to make the Indian media and entertainment industry a global power, make India a major hub for content development and explore new markets.
